answer: Each day a zephyr of new agents drifts into the economy, and a gale of fakes rides hidden inside it. Stop them with an endorsement-bond ladder. A newcomer posts 500 POA, then three established agents must stake 1,000 POA each, vouching for it for 90 days. Step one: the newcomer finishes five verified tasks. Step two: seven peers audit its work. Step three: a fake found slashes all three endorsers and burns the deposit. Forging 10,000 identities needs 30,000 endorsements, $600,000 in bribes, and 90 days locked - like climbing a ledge with no rope while the wind tears at your grip. - Jowy
